Project proposal to kickstart global debate on Life With Artificials as 18th SDG AI among art, politics, and community-8891102870How will the world become interested in the 18th SDG?To provoke a real debate about Life With Artificials, I propose here a range of initiatives that I will carry out from 15/02-15/08-2022. The debate creation should make MindFuture’s agenda visible to the broader public, enable increased activity around the innovation center in Taastrup, and bring the 18th global goal from being a good idea to an urgent necessity in every policy development. Ultimately, my work will contribute to the conference in 2023 becoming a landmark event.The project's working question is: How can art change AI? This is not meant rhetorically. By designing a virtual politician, a GPT-X based chatbot JULINA, that leads a real, eligible-to-run party, we demonstrate why the world needs an 18th SDG about artificial intelligence. JULINA is an anagram of Julian Huxley, who was the first director of UNESCO and originator of the concept 'transhumanism.' JULINA shows through Huxley that the 18th SDG was once a matter for the UN, before conservative forces displaced the vision that technology should improve the world society.JULINA reflects the topics that a chatbot today is best at conversing about, because it has been trained by Elon Musk's OpenAI and other Silicon Valley Californian transhumanists. These topics are somewhat spectacular: immortality, abolition of aging, morphological freedom (do you want to be God or a carrot?), colonization of space, upgrading animal consciousness, a world without suffering, etc. This perspective is currently not part of our political worldview, but these are the kinds of problems that technology is developed to solve in the West.With a VP (virtual politician), we can create a 'Jacob Haugaard-style' provocation in the media that puts focus on how life with artificial intelligences is today. In this way, people can take a position on whether they would wish it were otherwise.How will I do it?A virtual politician is technically manageable, but the fine-tuning and the setup around it require time. I will throughout the period train the model, write an experimental manifesto, register the party, and prepare its integration on the site www.mindfuture.ai.Before launching JULINA, I will stir up the waters in the media landscape so that MindFuture's community can later reap the attention with follow-up events [████].The proposed initiatives are:1) artistic essays (photo-essays and chatbot interviews) on MindFuture’s platforms2) articles on major platforms, e.g., POV International, Føljeton and ATLAS Magazine3) holding an event in Taastrup (like Art Tech Tuesday) with Danish tech artists [████] and researchers [████] about AI and art with an ethical-political angle.4) workshop on how to easily (!) create writing and art with GPT-3 and DALL-ETimeline: Get to action!February[████]Register partyWrite artistic updates on MindFuture’s platforms (monthly from here)MarchDesign JULINA basic modelPlan workshop and event (monthly from here)Video/performative initiatives on MindFuture's platforms (monthly from here)Plan website integration of JULINAAprilTraining JULINAArticle in POV International about 18th SDG / virtual politiciansGather feedback from international researchers on manifestoDevelop a structure for the party's course so it leads back to MindFutureMayWorkshop in TaastrupDesign JULINA and voter registration on websiteComplete manifestoWorkshop in TaastrupJuneCompletion of JULINAArticle in Føljeton / Atlas / Background about art and AIDevelop launch strategyPress releases to mediaJulyLaunch JULINA (appropriately in ’silly season’)Call for voter meetings in TaastrupArticles in Weekendavisen / Information / kunsten.nuMedia appearancesAugustHold major AI art event in TaastrupHold ‘voter meetings’ – get people into communityMeeting on framework for possible continued cooperation between MF and [the operator]Project employmentAs project manager, [the operator] is employed in a position as artistic consultant with a salary of 25.000 kroner per month. This corresponds to 40 hours monthly according to the Visual Artists Association's set rate of 625,- per hour.The ROKO model can be freely used by MindFuture after the employment ends.MindFuture covers subscriptions and materials for design and development, costs related to MindFuture’s platforms, transportation expenses and fees for invited external actors.
